skills.name: expo-router
skills.description: Expo Router rules for Modelence mobile apps — URL and group segment semantics, the canonical tabs layout, and the pre-completion checklist. Use before creating, moving, renaming, or linking any screen under mobile/app/.

skills.name: modelence-patterns
skills.description: Complete working examples of Modelence framework patterns — Module, Store, queries, mutations, configSchema, cron jobs, and React pages using modelenceQuery/modelenceMutation. Use when creating or modifying Modelence modules, stores, queries, mutations, cron jobs, migrations, or client pages that call them.
